t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pay attention to the size of the hats - the smaller hats to begin with pay better but the larger gats pay well if both gnomes are wearing a large hat in the later rounds

vb_textbox.text: The patterns appear to be inconsistent but I found that overall, green hates perfrom better when paired with pink hats. Orange hats perform better when paired with blue hats. Yellow hats perform better when paired with red hats. It can be benifitial to change it up every now and then however.
